decisive_items: soft tissue calcifications unrelated to bone or cartilage
calcified tissue with inflamed stroma and necrosis
response.rationale: Imaging and pathology directly confirm soft tissue calcifications, which is the hallmark of calcinosis. Elevated creatine kinase and low phosphorus support tissue calcification and muscle involvement. Scleroderma explains skin hardening but not the calcifications or CK elevation. Chronic granulomatous disease lacks specific evidence of granulomas or immune deficiency.

rejected.why: No granulomas or immune deficiency evidence; fevers and leukocytosis are nonspecific.
Skin hardening is present but calcifications and elevated CK are not typical of scleroderma.
